typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Savedatestoload_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		effectiveDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> getdatestoload
getdatestoload sink(input(
		effectiveDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		effectiveDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($Savedatestoload_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Savedatestoload
